coordinateSystem: top-left origin; logical pixels; path direction follows SVG d order

entryHandoff.preferred: H14 WEB-R205 actual Q90 when published
entryHandoff.transformRule: uniform contain; preserve complete original pixels and caption identity; replace with DOM Case evidence control after exit
entryHandoff.h14StatusAtDelivery: not published; WEB must compare H14 rect and hashes before X00 integration

merge-guide.direction: closed clockwise contour; decorative/operator focus only

dna-cassette-frame.flowDirection: left to right; show at most one authored inversion

responsive.mode: uniform contain within desktop viewport; text and controls remain DOM

consumerContract.mount: inline the SVG or fetch its XML, preserve IDs, and animate the production paths directly
consumerContract.pathMotion: use getTotalLength/getPointAtLength or Path2D from each listed d attribute; do not redraw substitute paths
consumerContract.copy: all words, values, equations, buttons, axes, and source labels are WEB DOM/canvas overlays
consumerContract.curve: the mathematical response curve is generated entirely by WEB from ln(1+9*x)/ln(10); the production SVG contains no baked response curve or data marks
consumerContract.pauseMotion: freeze parallax and pulses; retain readable static 0/1 and labels

scientificLimits: The space is an abstract teaching environment, not a bacterial interior.
OR and NOT are abstract rules, not capabilities demonstrated by the split-T7 case.
The continuous rail is normalized and has no experimental units.
The DNA schematic refers to a separate study and must not be attached to the Bradley PCA circuit.
QA previews are review artifacts only and must never be used as production slideshow backgrounds.
